ops.body: Landed 2026-07-20 as the generic MCP tool-spec registry. cc-transcript 14.4.0 (855c733, tag v14.4.0): Rust-core registry (McpToolSpec{behaves_like, span_edit key-map}, register/unregister_mcp_tool, process-local LazyLock<RwLock> keyed by bare MCP segment) replaces the deleted MCP_TOOL_ALIASES const; mcp_tool_alias/expand_tool_names/matches_names consult it; parse fallthrough lowers registered span-edit specs to the new SpanEditCall native view (file_path, new; None=delete; no pre-image, hunks_of empty, file_path_of resolves); mining name-set expansions deferred to call time. Binding is declarative data in the cc-context ccx pack manifest ([tools] table, pack 0.9.0, cc-context db0e52ac + plugin 0.28.3 6000b25a). Consumer capt-hook 10.5.0 (8f59fe38, tag v10.5.0): PackManifest parses [tools], CliState.discover() registers with diff-reconcile + daemon snapshot-hit re-reconcile, SpanEditCall arms in content/replaced/pre_image, comments touched() span fallback gated on SpanEditCall, pin cc-transcript>=14.4,<14.5 (14.5 async inversion tracked in capt-hook's own backlog). Live smoke: released capt-hook + shipped plugin manifest deny a >4-line comment ccx_code_edit on both cold and hookd paths; short/delete stay silent.
